title: Middle Eastern Lentils and Rice with Crispy Onions
summary: A comforting vegan rice and lentil dish topped with deeply golden crispy onions. It’s savoury, warmly spiced, and perfect for a simple weeknight dinner.
steps: Rinse the lentils and rice separately until the water runs mostly clear. Thinly slice the onions.

Heat 3 tbsp of the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onions with 1 tsp of the salt and cook slowly for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden brown and crisp. Transfer them to a plate with a slotted spoon.

In a medium pot, combine the lentils, 700 ml of the water, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, black pepper, and the remaining salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 to 18 minutes until the lentils are tender but not mushy.
Add the rice and the remaining 200 ml water to the lentils. Stir once, cover, and cook on low heat for 12 to 15 minutes until the rice is fluffy and the liquid is absorbed.
Turn off the heat and let the pot rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice and lentils with a fork, then stir through the chopped parsley.
Top with the crispy onions and drizzle over the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil before serving.
